en.name: Eucharistic Sustenance of Marthe Robin
en.summary: A French mystic reported to have lived over five decades without food, sustained only by the Eucharist.
en.body: Marthe Robin, bedridden and paralyzed for most of her adult life, was reported to have taken no nourishment but weekly Holy Communion for fifty-three years, while experiencing the stigmata each Friday. She went on to found the Foyers de Charité communities.
